s1.desc: a living room drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a kitchen with a curved counter, a cream fridge and an archway into the living room

spans.view: with a cream sofa with yellow scallop-shell armrests

beats.text: Pax sits beside Polly on the sofa and reaches over to take her flipper in his
Pax holds Polly's flipper up to his beak and kisses it with his eyes closed while Polly watches him
Pax lets go and flings both flippers up in the air with a wide open-beaked smile
Pax throws his flippers around Polly and presses his face to her cheek, blushing, while Polly shuts one eye and smiles with her beak open
Pax hugs Polly tight with his eyes closed as small red hearts float up above them, while Polly smiles shyly in his arms
